## Updates

- Prevent preview images from oveflowing the height and going outside of the viewport.
- Fix danbooru wiki search.
- Fix up/down keys not working in the tags textarea when creating a new tag group. (#41)
- Add saved UI state for tag filter mode, sort modes, sort order, selected autotagger models and the 3 checkbox settings in the autotagger tab. (#42)
- Preserve top scrolling in the dataset images grid when switching tabs. (#43)
- Make preview image zoom follow the cursor instead of always zooming towards the middle. (#44)
- Escape tag hints and improve tag autocompletion matching and sort suggestions by result count. (#45)
- Select the previous image when the selected one dissapears from the filtered results. (#46)
- Modify collapse all buttons into dropdown buttons that allow to either collapse or expand all. (#47)
- Make the tags in the tag group editor draggable with undo/redo actions. (#48)
- Preserve previous position when restoring a deleted tag from tag groups and improve undo/redo action types.
- Add undo/redo actions for imported tag groups and add a button to save the tag groups.
- Add editable tag chips and a shortcut (Shift + click) for them. (#49)
- Allow to select and reorder multiple tags at once (Ctrl + click). (#50)
- Enable contains mode in From and To autocomplete inputs in the mass edit interface. (#45)
- Use the filtered images when applying the backgrounds, not all the selected images.
- Be able to delete the default tagger models from the list. (#55)
- Add huggingface token setting alongside with plain or encrypted string fields. (#53)
- Replace pip with uv for dependency management and venv creation. (#54)
- Support timm (safetensor) models, support per-tag thresholds, support category thresholds, improve UI state error handling, improve modal design for adding and editing tagger models. (#52)
- Fix a bug where a bad timing can make the starting of the tagger service stuck when switching tabs and fix another stuck route. (#56)
- Add xet high-performance mode setting for tagger model downloads. (#57)

## Download Options

| Platform | File | Type | Automatic Updates |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Windows | `.exe` | Installer | Yes |
| Windows | `.zip` | Portable | No |
| Linux | `.AppImage` | Portable application | Yes |
| Linux | `.deb` | Debian package | Yes |
| Linux | `.rpm` | RPM package | Yes |
